entries.category_description: Temporary Exemptions, super-reduced or reduced rates (Article 105a(2) of the VAT Directive)
entries.code_description: Carbon paper, self-copy paper and other copying or transfer papers (including coated or impregnated paper for duplicator stencils or offset plates), whether or not printed, in rolls or sheets
entries.comment: paper needed for their printing and the printing of acts and publications of the Chamber of Deputies and Senate of the Republic; printed matter and similar material relating to electoral campaigns if commissioned by candidates or their lists or by political parties or movements of political opinion;The reduced rate also applies to paper and printed matter.
